text:
julio: PR #10214 ready for merge — adds traffic-aware routing shim. blocked: need architecture/lightweight-RFC link & signoff. pinging @ara for eyes.
nina: quick ask — can you add a one-line summary of risk and SLO impact in the PR description?
julio: done, added summary + brief canary plan (10% traffic for 6h, watch p95 and error rate). RFC link incoming.
ben: @ara fyi this touches the routing fallback path and the shard-leader interface. a fast ok would unblock tonight's release.
ara: drop the RFC URL here and call out compatibility with existing guardrails. don't want to chase into the PR.
julio: RFC (draft): https://rfs.redwood/team/infra/routing-shim-2026 — includes compatibility section. TL;DR: fallback preserves previous route semantics, adds a pinning policy. estimated SLO delta: +2ms p95 for pinned requests.
ara: reading now. also please add a short test matrix and explicit canary roll-back criteria (exact thresholds).
julio: added test matrix and rollback criteria to PR description. Canary rollback: >2% user-facing errors OR p95 latency regresses >15% vs baseline for 15m.
nina: tagging SRE — can we get monitoring/runbook linked to the PR? @sre-lead
sre-lead: got it. I'll add the runbook and create alerts for the canary thresholds. do we want a maintenance window?
julio: prefer no maintenance window. planning canary in off-peak (00:30–06:30 PST).
ben: if arch signs off, i can run a perf sanity and merge during the 01:00 PST slot.
ara: one clarification while reading: how do pinned requests interact with dedicated capacity routing? please add a short paragraph in the RFC.
julio: added paragraph and pinged eng-platform owners. @ben can you confirm the dedicated-cap path is unchanged?
ben: confirmed — dedicated capacity routing unaffected. shim only flips for hosted fallback path. LGTM from my side once tests remain green.
deploy-bot: Build succeeded for PR #10214 — all tests green. :ok_hand:
ara: ok — arch gives a lightweight blessing with the added paragraph and the test matrix. @julio you are cleared to merge during the planned slot. please post a canary-check comment after 30m.
julio: thanks everyone — merging at 01:15 PST and will report back with canary metrics.
